Tra gli studenti ieri sera all'Università di Ghent c'erano anche dei ragazzi che non condividono le mie idee.
Gentili, educati, e con domande vere: cosí nasce un confronto autentico e un dibattito costruttivo.

⤵️Ecco una delle domande a cui ho risposto
text: Is it correct to say that Israel's state was created inside another nation? Like, I'm from Italy, I can imagine that at some point I wake up and a new state is introducing my state. Well, at that time it was totally different. You know that at that time a lot of states were created from nothing. They were just drawn on the maps. It's very simple. You just see the borders between Iraq and Syria or Iraq and Iran. They are, you know, straight forward lines because at that time most of all a British protectorate and when the state were designed, they were designed on a map. So it's different the way of, you know, the states were created. And you think about Iraq. Iraq has three entities inside these borders. They have the Shia in the south, the Sani in the center, and the Kurds in the north. And nothing is linked between them. It's just a state that was designed by partners. And the same Palestine was not existing. It was a protectorate of Great Britain. It was part of the Ottoman Empire before. So we cannot argue that it was a state created inside the state. So you were there and expelled people? Well, you know, it was a progressive colonization of regions. Yes, we can say that. If you want me to say that, I will tell you, yes, it was a progressive colonization of one area. Yes, we cannot go, in my opinion, we cannot go 85 years ago to fix this problem. We need to think about nowadays. Yeah, I mean, so you cannot go to the Indians in America to fix the problem of the Indian reserves. We need to think about nowadays. So what would you do tomorrow? Your idea is to go in Israel and say, no, Israel doesn't exist anymore. Go away. Now we have Palestinian state. Would it be a solution? I mean. I mean. Would it be a solution? Simple. No, it's not enough. When you decide a strategy in the military, you know, the first characteristic is the feasibility. Can you do it? No. So keep it away. So do you think that erasing the state of Israel is feasible? In my opinion, it's not feasible. So it's not monochial. Very pragmatic. I am not pro-Israel or pro-Palestine. I am pragmatic.
